text:
Alex: Quick thread — follow-up items from the KV-cache OOM postmortem. Need owners/timelines for profiling, GC/frag mitigation, soft-limits, and recurring-pattern detection. I'll list proposals; please pick owners and ETA.

Morgan: Can we get the flamegraphs / heap diffs? I noticed a residency spike tied to prefix queries ~03:40UTC. I can pull traces and timeline.

Sophia: I'll run targeted alloc profiles on a canary shard today. ETA EOD. Will upload pprof + hot function list.

Jamie: Assigning owners for initial work: Sophia -> profiling + pprof artifacts. Leo -> eviction/soft-limit experiment. Morgan -> tracing + dashboard panels/alerts. Alex -> coordinator + postmortem action tracker. Goal: PRs/notes by Mon 09:00 PT.

Leo: On soft-limits: propose a 2-stage eviction config prototype: `eviction: { \"soft_percent\": 0.75, \"hard_percent\": 0.92 }`. Will bench and check tail latency impact. Need a harness for sustained traffic.

Morgan: Added dashboard: /dashboards/kv-residency-heatmap (internal). Also added alert rule: `kv.residency > 0.8 for 5m` -> Pager. Let me know if thresholds ok.

incident-bot: Incident INF-4123 created for 2026-03-18 KV OOM. Postmortem draft: http://incidents/internal/INF-4123. Owners copied from thread.

Sophia: Initial pprof shows allocation cluster in `shard_manager::snapshot` growing with prefix cache. ~38% allocs from small strings + key copies. Plan: try small-string intern pool + reduce transient copying.

Alex: For GC/fragmentation: proposal to test a compacting GC pass during low-traffic windows and increase slab coalescing. Risk: pause behavior. Need canary + rollback.

Jamie: Action items recap: Sophia -> open PR for intern-pool + unit tests. Leo -> open experiment PR for soft-limits and eviction strategy. Morgan -> add retention, perf test, and pattern-detection cron. Alex -> update postmortem and track timeline. Target: PRs by Mon; canary next Wed; rollout after perf thresholds met.

Leo: I'll run synthetic load (100k qps short bursts) and report latency/cost delta. If fragmentation drops, we can widen slab coalescing and tweak alloc hinting.

Morgan: Recurring pattern: saw similar residency spikes in last 3 incidents. I'll add a pattern tag to INF-4123 and run a 90-day query to get top-10 keys/clients driving growth.

Sophia: Uploading pprof blobs to INF-4123 now and attaching sample trace: http://ci.internal/pprof/pprof-3355.gz

Alex: Also add 'oncall' steps to the rollout playbook: auto-fallback route + smaller-quantized model fallback on OOM threshold. And add runbook entry 'kv-residency-surge' with mitigation steps.

Jamie: :thumbsup: I'll update the runbook and block a 30-min sync Tue 10:00 PT to review PRs + canary plan.

Leo: Self-assigning measurement owner for evictions/latency/backlog. Will post metric snapshots in this thread.

Sophia: EOD update: uploaded pprof + mini harness to INF-4123. Initial intern-pool microbench looks promising (~18% less alloc churn).

Alex: Thanks everyone. Keep updates in INF-4123 and ping #eng-oncall with risky changes. We'll reconvene Tue.
